gbm_population_evidence.quote: STEP 2 REGISTRATION: Histopathologically proven diagnosis of glioblastoma (or gliosarcoma as a subtype of glioblastoma) confirmed by central pathology review

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase III trial compares the effect of adding lomustine to standard chemotherapy with temozolomide and radiation therapy versus temozolomide and radiation therapy alone in shrinking or stabilizing newly diagnosed MGMT methylated glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Testing the Addition of the Chemotherapy Drug Lomustine (Gleostine) to the Usual Treatment (Temozolomide and Radiation Therapy) for Newly Diagnosed MGMT Methylated Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Patients also receive lomustine PO on day 1 of each cycle and temozolomide PO QD on days 2-6 of each cycle.

To determine if the regimen with the two alkylating agents temozolomide and lomustine with radiotherapy (RT) significantly prolongs overall survival (OS) versus (vs.) standard chemoradiotherapy with temozolomide

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent, established GBM therapy
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: It damages the cell's DNA and may kill tumor cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

source_quote.quote: STEP 2 REGISTRATION: MGMT promoter with methylation confirmed by central pathology review.
IDH mutation testing by at least one method (such as immunohistochemistry for IDH1 R132H) must be performed as part of standard of care and no mutation must be found (i.e IDH wildtype).

coder_notes: Lomustine is an established GBM therapy (D6) investigated in a new setting (added to Stupp in MGMT-methylated newly diagnosed GBM) -> established_therapy_experiment; temozolomide in both arms -> soc_backbone. No candidate, so S6 fails with established_therapy_only. Temozolomide schedule differs between arms (days 2-6 of 42-day cycles in Arm II) but this is part of the lomustine-TMZ regimen. MGMT methylation is an entry requirement but never candidate-matched. IDH-wildtype required -> cns5. Control arm is registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR (CODE layer), no OTHER-type arms.
